{{Quote|Don't worry. I have enough clones with me to take ''three'' systems the size of Utapau. I think I'll be able to handle the situation, even ''without'' your help.|Obi-Wan Kenobi to Anakin Skywalker|<ref name="Episode 3">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
The '''Utapau system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Tarabba sector/Legends|Tarabba sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]], a sinkhole world orbited by nine moons. The system centered around the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Utapau (star)/Legends|Utapau]].
